title: USDZ Round-Trip — Import, Export, Re-Import
description: End-to-end check of the USDZ exporter. USDZ is Pixar's ZIP-packaged USD format for portable 3D scene assets. Loads the ResidentialBuilding USDZ into a temporary SceneModel, writes it back out with USDZExporter, then re-imports the exported bytes into the displayed SceneModel.
